a1.criterion: A1: the read states the question the page answers and names one concrete file/path action. Empty and all-test correctly return the named stub/no-production answer; no-entry names the hottest file in the header.
framing_notes: capped: the depth-1 column is taller than the 1440x900 first screen (canvas viewBox 1248, rendered 1255px); 20 of 26 reachable files shown, 6 aggregated, printed. Both reads name src/f0.c; the first screen still carries entry, HOTTEST and PATH. This is a framing limitation disclosed for A2, not an A1 failure.

no-entry / empty / all-test: the canvas is intentionally a named stub with no graph; there are no canvas line numbers anywhere by design (the answer line and KV1 below the canvas carry the path:line action).

fixes_during_gate: Report body width 72rem -> 90rem so the 1400-unit SVG renders at the canonical 1440 width instead of scaling to 0.83x.
SVG typography floors: node name >=10px, meta >=8.5px, badges >=8px, headers >=10.5px; four-line node text; 46px minimum node height; 12px row gap.
Two-line column headers so the UNREACHED header cannot collide with depth-0.
Compact edge pills (visible ×N; full 'N distinct structural edge' in title) with a legend key; deterministic pill/node collision avoidance.
Component hull label moved 16px above the first node (13px above its badge).
First-screen .atlas-keys line: units relative scale, × median function = all functions in the scan, edge ×N key, numbered path badges, structural caption.
Capture hygiene: prefers-reduced-motion + animations disabled + mouse parked at (1,1) so native SVG title tooltips are not captured.
Panel round: scale-aware preflight (rendered font sizes via getScreenCTM), aggregate text raised to 9.1/8.6, v1-aware first-screen unit label, edge-count clamp ×999+, manifest html paths fixed.

observations: A1: every state's first 1440x900 frame names the question it answers and at least one concrete file action; 16/16 reads pass, all high confidence.

The weight strip is used in every state to answer N4 (mass/share): 16/16 answer N4; 11/16 name a top file/component in the `action` field and 14/16 name a top item/band in `mass_answer`; the five `none` actions are the correct empty/all-test/capped-tie answers. No read compared a share to a multiple or inferred time.
The component label 'src' was read as 'SIC' in 3/16 strip reads (no-entry B, single-file A/B); the mass, shares and actions were still correct. Minor label-clarity observation for A2.

The capped canvas is taller than the viewport (viewBox 1248, rendered 1255px); the 1440x900 first screen is a framing choice, not a data truncation (20 of 26 shown, 6 aggregated, printed). A2 judges large-repo usability.
No schema change, no new Atlas script, no new dependency; only the four report.html goldens changed. Holdouts stayed vaulted.
